mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, which reduces real interest rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth below -10,000 jobs triggers a risk-on equity response, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during weakening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production above 100.5 points signals accelerating economic demand, which lowers real interest rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production below 100.5 points signals weakening economic supply, which raises real interest rates and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in supply periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 3 months signals disinflation, lowering real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% triggers a risk-on equity response, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
